title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: usage-based billing models in the model selector
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing requirements, billing controls and rollout windows are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. Minor corrections would make two navigation paths more complete and add a source explicitly linking the models to Cost Management.

claims.claim: The planned change exposes usage-based billing models through the Chat model selector.
claims.quote: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: General Availability is targeted for December CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: Preview is targeted for November CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Desktop and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Desktop", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap says tenant administrators must provide credits for users to interact with these models.
claims.quote: Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans requests to tenant administrators for more credits after users consume their allotment.
claims.quote: If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

claims.claim: MC1519122 announces GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 as generally available UBB models with this rollout.
claims.quote: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 will be generally available as UBB models with this rollout.

claims.claim: The notice preserves the models' previously communicated eligibility requirements.
claims.quote: Previously communicated eligibility requirements for these models apply.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users cannot access UBB models unless UBB is enabled.
claims.quote: Users will not have access to UBB models unless UBB is enabled.

claims.claim: The notice also covers Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
claims.quote: These models will be available from Chat in the Microsoft Copilot app and when using Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: The notice says users will be able to set reasoning effort when using a UBB model in Chat.
claims.quote: Additionally, users will be able to set the reasoning effort level when using a UBB model in Chat.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: In-product requests for additional credits are planned after the initial rollout.
claims.quote: We plan to rollout the ability for users to request credits from their tenant admins after this initial rollout.

claims.claim: MC1519122 gives no date for the later credit-request rollout.
claims.quote: After the initial rollout, we plan to roll out the ability for users to request additional credits from their tenant admin.

claims.claim: MC1519122 was updated on 4 November 2026.
claims.quote: Updated November 4, 2026: We have updated the rollout schedule below.

claims.claim: The notice schedules Frontier (Public) to begin in early November 2026.
claims.quote: Frontier (Public): Beginning early November 2026

claims.claim: The notice expects Frontier (Public) completion by mid-November 2026.
claims.quote: Frontier (Public): Beginning early November 2026 and expected to complete by mid-November 2026

claims.claim: The notice schedules Worldwide General Availability to begin in early December 2026, previously early November.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in early December 2026 (previously early November)

claims.claim: The notice expects Worldwide General Availability rollout completion by mid-December 2026.
claims.quote: expected to complete by mid-December 2026 (previously mid-November)

claims.claim: The notice identifies users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot USL and UBB enabled as affected.
claims.quote: Users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription license (USL) with UBB enabled

claims.claim: The licensing model for this additional capability is consumption.
claims.quote: UBB experiences consume Copilot Credits and require a USL for access.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Access requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription licence.
claims.quote: UBB experiences consume Copilot Credits and require a USL for access.

claims.where: summary; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Enabled UBB and provided credits are additional requirements, not replacements for the USL.
claims.quote: Verify that users have a Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription license (USL).- Enable UBB for users who should have access to the models.- Allocate credits to users who should have access to the models.

claims.claim: The capability is admin-opt-in because UBB must be enabled for access.
claims.quote: Tenant admins responsible for enabling usage-based billing and allocating credits

claims.claim: The USL is the fixed-price foundation covering everyday AI.
claims.quote: The USL covers everyday AI work, providing a fixed-price AI foundation for your workforce.

claims.claim: UBB covers advanced AI and frontier models beyond everyday AI included in the USL.
claims.quote: UBB is used for advanced AI and frontier models, extending beyond the everyday AI included in the USL.

claims.claim: There are already subscription-covered model choices.
claims.quote: Model selection is also part of the USL, with some models included with fair use, such as GPT 5.6 and Sonnet, and others included with limits, such as Opus.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Interaction with UBB models consumes Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: UBB is used in Copilot for capabilities such as Cowork, Code, Autopilot, new agentic experiences in SharePoint, or when working with newer agentic frontier models such as Astra and Fable. UBB experiences consume Copilot Credits and require a USL for access.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Direct cost is variable, metered in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Usage-based billing means charges are based on the work performed rather than a flat per-user fee.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn publishes no Chat-specific per-model credit rate for GPT-6 Astra or Claude Fable 5.1 at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: GPT-6 Astra Claude Fable 5.1 Copilot Credits rates; separate Astra/Fable rate queries. Read USL/UBB, billing setup, comparison, overview and pay-as-you-go meters; Studio billing-rate search excerpts concern agents, not these Chat models.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go bills credit consumption to a linked Azure subscription.
claims.quote: If you choose to override by using the pay-as-you-go option, the connected Azure subscription is billed on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Copilot Credit Pre-purchase Plan (P3) is a supported credit funding method.
claims.quote: Some subscriptions show an X pre-purchase credits available label. This label indicates that a Copilot Credit Pre-purchase plan (P3) is attached.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Existing prepaid capacity packs can fund these managed services.
claims.quote: If you purchased capacity packs, you can use them with the services in this experience.

claims.claim: P3 provides discounted commit units.
claims.quote: Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans provide discounted commit units for eligible Copilot Credit usage during a one-year term.

claims.claim: P3 has a one-year term.
claims.quote: Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans provide discounted commit units for eligible Copilot Credit usage during a one-year term.

claims.claim: Usage beyond P3 credits can be billed as pay-as-you-go when pay-as-you-go is enabled.
claims.quote: Usage beyond available pre-purchased credits can be billed as pay-as-you-go if pay-as-you-go is enabled.

claims.claim: Administrators must set up a billing policy before users can use AI experiences requiring UBB.
claims.quote: Admins must set up a billing policy before a user can use AI experiences that require usage-based billing.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Identity-based spending policies govern user or group access.
claims.quote: Create and name the policy and then choose Identity as the scope. Use this option when you need to manage usage by users or groups for a supported service.

claims.claim: Spending policies define access and limits rather than reserving or allocating credits to users or groups.
claims.quote: Spending policies only define access and spending limits, not credit allocation.

claims.claim: When a user moves between Entra ID groups, the new group's spending policy becomes effective.
claims.quote: If a user moves from one Microsoft Entra ID group to another during a billing period, the new group's spending policy becomes effective for the user.

claims.claim: The user's consumption history carries forward after a group policy change.
claims.quote: Credits consumed under the previous spending policy remain part of the user's consumption history and are accounted for when enforcing the spending limit under the new policy.

claims.where: summary; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can configure policy-level monthly credit limits.
claims.quote: When you select a limited monthly budget, you limit the number of credits that this policy can spend each month.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure per-user monthly credit limits.
claims.quote: Select monthly budget limits for users (optional). Use the toggle to select this option and to set a monthly limit for users to prevent a single person from spending all available credits.

claims.claim: Spending-policy alerts notify recipients at configured thresholds.
claims.quote: Select the administrators or stakeholders who must receive email notifications when policy usage reaches the threshold.

claims.claim: At the configured limit users lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month.
claims.quote: When users hit the limit, they lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month until credits reset on the first of the month.

claims.claim: A running task exceeding a per-user limit in a group policy can complete without interruption.
claims.quote: Users in a group spending policy that exceed their per-user spending limit: If a running task exceeds the per-user limit, it can complete without interruption.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Microsoft Copilot are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: Claude models are also currently excluded from applicable in-country processing commitments.
claims.quote: currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary, and when applicable, in-country processing commitments.

claims.claim: Microsoft Product Terms and DPA apply when Anthropic acts as a Microsoft subprocessor, except for Data Retention models.
claims.quote: Unless models are labeled "Anthropic models with Data Retention," the Microsoft Product Terms and Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply to the use of Claude models from Anthropic through Microsoft's enterprise Online Services.

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention are off by default.
claims.quote: Anthropic models with Data Retention (such as Fable 5.0) have additional controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center and are off by default for all scenarios

claims.claim: Data Retention models require a separate explicit tenant administrator opt-in.
claims.quote: No users will have access to these models until the tenant admin explicitly opts in to enable use of Anthropic models with Data Retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Anthropic's own terms apply to models with Data Retention.
claims.quote: Anthropic acts as an independent processor and use of Anthropic models with Data Retention is subject to acceptance of Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Anthropic's Data Protection Addendum

claims.claim: Fable-class models can have different terms, so Fable 5.1's terms should not be assumed for other Fable-class models.
claims.quote: Certain Claude models, such as Fable 5.0 and Fable 5.1, may be made available to your organization with different or additional terms

claims.claim: Requests not matching a custom request policy continue through Microsoft's credit request service and can be resolved in the admin center.
claims.quote: Requests that don't match a custom request policy continue through the Microsoft credit request service and can be resolved in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls: Credit requests path
claims.claim: Credit requests are reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Overview > Top Actions > View requests.
claims.quote: go to Copilot > Cost Management. ... Select the Overview tab. ... From the Top Actions section, you can View requests ... To view and approve credit requests from end users, select View requests. The Credit requests page displays all pending and approved requests.

claims.claim: The documentation does not explicitly connect requests initiated from the new Chat model selector to the existing Credit requests page.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat UBB model selector credit requests. Read MC1519122, USL/UBB, Monitor Copilot Credit spending and Cost Management API overview; they describe planned selector requests and generic credit-request handling, not that entry-point mapping.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: How the new metered model options appear to users without UBB and credits is not established.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat UBB model selector hide disabled models. Read MC1519122, USL/UBB, discovery setting and access-request setting; none specifies the new selector's hidden-versus-disabled presentation.

claims.claim: The comparison article describes the admin center view as credits-only.
claims.quote: Everything in this view is expressed in Copilot Credits, not currency.

claims.claim: The comparison article says dashboard totals and exports may be point-in-time views.
claims.quote: Dashboard totals and exports might be point-in-time views and can refresh at different intervals.

claims.claim: The monitoring article documents estimated cost in local currency including negotiated rates.
claims.quote: Cost: The estimated cost of your AI usage in local currency, including negotiated rates.

claims.claim: The monitoring article warns that the estimated cost may not match the bill.
claims.quote: It includes usage paid for with prepaid credits and with pay-as-you-go, so it might not match your bill.

claims.claim: The monitoring article describes exports as point-in-time snapshots.
claims.quote: Exported reports are generated as a point-in-time snapshot

claims.claim: The monitoring article says dashboard views continue retrieving live data.
claims.quote: while dashboard views continue to retrieve live data.

claims.claim: Global administrators can add, select and change billing methods.
claims.quote: Global administrator and Billing administrator roles can add, select, and change billing methods, and set billing methods in policies.

claims.claim: Billing administrators can add, select and change billing methods.
claims.quote: Global administrator and Billing administrator roles can add, select, and change billing methods, and set billing methods in policies.

claims.claim: AI administrators can edit spending policies and manage limits and alerts.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods.

claims.claim: The setup page inconsistently describes License administrators as both policy editors and read-only readers.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies ... AI Reader, Global Reader, License Administrator, and other supported reader-based roles ... don't allow administrators to create or change spending policies

claims.claim: AI administrators and License administrators cannot create spending policies.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods. However, they can't create spending policies.

claims.claim: Supported reader roles can view consumption.
claims.quote: AI Reader, Global Reader, License Administrator, and other supported reader-based roles can view consumption dashboards and reports.

claims.claim: Government-cloud rollout dates for this UBB selector change are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/copilot UBB GCC models Chat. Read roadmap, MC1519122, USL/UBB and Anthropic government-cloud search excerpts; general Claude availability does not provide dates for this UBB selector rollout.

claims.claim: Spending policies, limits and alerts are managed at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot > Cost Management. ... Select the Configuration tab. ... Select the spending policy you want to edit. ... The spending policy details fly-out opens, where you can modify its settings.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and the matching table path to 'Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > policy'. The cited page says to select the spending policy before modifying its settings.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id} updates spending-policy limits.
claims.quote: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/3f9e2c1a-0000-0000-0000-00000000c21b

claims.claim: The spending-policy update body can set periodLimit.
claims.quote: The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The spending-policy update body can set perUserLimit.
claims.quote: The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: The printed spending-policy PATCH call does not configure alerts.
claims.quote: In the request body, supply only the values for the properties to update. The following properties can be updated: displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and billingMethods.

claims.claim: Beta APIs are subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change.

claims.claim: Use of the beta API in production applications is unsupported.
claims.quote: Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Request eligibility is configured at Copilot > Settings > All Settings > Access to usage-based billing experiences.
claims.quote: Go to Copilot > Settings > All Settings. ... Select Access to usage-based billing experiences. ... In the fly-out pane, under Choose who can request a spending policy
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the matching table path to 'Copilot > Settings > All Settings > Access to usage-based billing experiences > Choose who can request a spending policy', adding the omitted setting heading.

claims.claim: Configuring access requests requires the Global administrator role.
claims.quote: To configure the setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center, you need to be assigned to the Global administrator role.

claims.claim: Access-request setting changes can take up to 24 hours.
claims.quote: Changes to this setting might take up to 24 hours to apply.

claims.claim: The access-request setting does not itself complete UBB setup.
claims.quote: Your selection controls who can request access. It does not complete the usage-based billing setup by itself.

claims.claim: No users in the access-request setting prevents requests for a spending policy rather than hiding or blocking UBB models.
claims.quote: No users: Users cannot request a spending policy. Instead, they'll be presented with a link to learn more about Advanced AI experiences that require usage-based billing.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent is documented for choosing who may request a UBB spending policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Access to usage-based billing experiences request spending policy settings API; requestAccessSettings copilot. Read access-request page and Cost Management API operations list; no request-eligibility-setting write is documented.

claims.claim: The Anthropic access path follows Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic > Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences.
claims.quote: Copilot > Settings > View all. ... AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic ... Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences, select your users or groups

claims.claim: Anthropic access configuration requires AI Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.claim: The Anthropic setting controls which users or groups may use Claude models in Copilot.
claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences. When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.claim: The cited Anthropic setting and processing-terms documentation concern Claude models, not GPT-6 Astra.
claims.quote: Claude models from Anthropic in Microsoft Online Services ... Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences, select your users or groups

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent is documented for this tenant Anthropic provider-access setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Anthropic AI providers operating Microsoft subprocessors settings API PowerShell; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Anthropic settings. Read Anthropic subprocessor and Anthropic apps pages; results document UI controls, not a provider-access write API.

claims.claim: The AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing discovery setting is deprecated.
claims.quote: The AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing setting is deprecated.

claims.claim: The discovery setting governs visibility, whereas Cost Management governs access and spending.
claims.quote: this setting controls visibility, while Cost Management under the Copilot node in the Microsoft 365 admin center controls access and spending.

claims.claim: Azure Cost Management shows pay-as-you-go charges for the linked Azure subscription.
claims.quote: Use Azure Cost Management and Azure billing views to understand billed charges for the Azure subscription connected to your billing method.

claims.claim: Azure Cost Management shows P3 purchase or amortized costs.
claims.quote: Azure Cost Management shows pay-as-you-go charges and purchase or amortized cost information for Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans (P3) and Microsoft Agent pre-purchase plans (P3).

claims.claim: Azure Cost Management does not show consumption against prepaid capacity packs.
claims.quote: Azure Cost Management doesn't show consumption against Prepaid Capacity packs.

claims.claim: Prepaid capacity-pack usage is monitored in the Microsoft 365 or Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Use the Microsoft 365 admin center or Power Platform admin center, as applicable, to monitor Prepaid Capacity Pack credit usage.

claims.claim: A spending policy can automatically apply to future supported services when Auto-apply new services is enabled.
claims.quote: When the setting is on, newly supported Microsoft Copilot services and agents are automatically added to the policy.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls: spending-policy applicability
claims.claim: Cost Management spending policies govern UBB models in Copilot Chat and Office.
claims.quote: Services managed by usage-based billing in the Microsoft admin center now include: ... Models with usage-based billing in Copilot Chat and Office
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/usage-based-billing-overview-copilot-credits to sources; its services table explicitly lists 'Models with usage-based billing in Copilot Chat and Office'.
